finding: Dangling-link test builds its expected reason from verdict.folder, not from an independent expected path
why: The sibling test pins `folder = os.path.realpath(elsewhere)`; this one accepts any folder text the verdict reports, so a wrong but consistent folder passes.
fix: Assert the folder against the expected value per case: `os.path.realpath(elsewhere)` for the checked target, `root / 'proj'` for the new target.
evidence: assert verdict.rule == "R-06" and verdict.reason == f"{verdict.folder} is not a folder; pick another short name"
